items.title: AirTag lawsuit challenges how easily tracking alerts can be disabled
items.snippet: A new AirTag lawsuit puts Apple's handling of disabled tracking alerts at the center of a demand for stronger safeguards. Apple sued over AirTag alerts disabled with iPhone passcode A Washington woman is suing Apple after alleging AirTag safeguards failed to prevent tracking during domestic abuse. According to the complaint, seen by King5 , one tracker was found in her son's diaper bag, while a second was found hidden inside the rear-seat upholstery of the her car. items.title: AI component hikes force the world's largest PC makers to return manufacturing capacity to China
items.snippet: PC manufacturing in China tends to be cheaper because of an established supply chain and workforce. Smaller Chinese suppliers are also winning orders by offering easier access to domestic chip manufacturers like CXMT.

items.title: US Marines join NATO mission in the Baltic Sea to protect undersea cables from sabotage as Russia continues to lurk
items.snippet: 50 U.S. marines are joining a NATO mission to help protect and monitor undersea infrastructure in the Baltic Sea.

items.title: Seagate's 16TB external HDD falls to 0.025 cents per GB at Newegg
items.snippet: Save $150 on this 16TB Seagate Expansion Desktop External HDD when you make use of this Newegg deal.

items.title: Why native PC ports of console games are suddenly everywhere
items.snippet: With dozens of titles unofficially ported to PC over the past few months, the big questions are: why is this now possible, and what changed?

items.title: Nvidia RTX GPU vendor Palit denies its Galax factory has closed due to a shortage of chips
items.snippet: Palit denies news that Galax is going out of production.

items.title: Save $249 on 32GB of DDR5 with this 9800X3D parts bundle
items.snippet: Save $248.99 on this AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D bundle at Newegg with an MSI MAG X870E Tomahawk Max Wifi motherboard and 32GB of DDR5-6000 RAM, now just $1,094.99.

items.title: Standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs land in Oracle Cloud's multi-gigawatt deployment
items.snippet: Nvidia’s Vera CPU is now generally available on Oracle’s OCI Superclusters, a win for Nvidia as it moves past NVL72 to a standalone Vera deployment at a major hyperscaler.

items.title: IT vendor lists massive $60 million AI supercomputer on eBay with 300 racks of decommissioned GPUs
items.snippet: Someone listed a massive 300-rack AI supercomputer on eBay for $59.7M. Packed with 9,600 A100 GPUs and 4,200 EPYC CPUs, it even ships for free.

items.title: Military drone outfit Anduril partners with Qualcomm to build laptops on US soil with new BlueChip venture
items.snippet: The defense contractor aims to fully bring back laptop manufacturing on U.S. shores, with its first BlueChip laptop prototypes having 90% procurement cost coming from suppliers in the U.S. and other allied countries.

items.title: TSMC reportedly weighs 20% CoWoS price increase as Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin chips put pressure on packaging capacity
items.snippet: TSMC is reportedly weighing a price increase of up to 20% for its CoWoS advanced packaging technology as Nvidia’s Blackwell and upcoming Rubin chips intensify pressure on capacity. Equipment deliveries now reportedly take up to eight months, while separate wafer-price increases of 5% to 10% are expected in 2027, with some customers potentially facing total cost increases of up to 25%.

items.title: Samsung Portable SSD P9 review: speedy USB4 in a slim, pricey package
items.snippet: Samsung’s Portable SSD P9 is the new USB4 external drive to beat. It feels premium and performed very well in our testing. But you’ll have to pay a lot for it, or any similarly performing drive, these days.

items.title: Walmart slashes $750 off this MSI RTX 5060 gaming laptop
items.snippet: A massive $750 discount at Walmart brings the price of MSI's Crosshair gaming laptop crashing down. RTX 5060 graphics and a bright 240Hz IPS display are just two of the standout features of this laptop.

items.title: Intel's APX offers 'better performance' in Windows 11 according to new Insider setting
items.snippet: Microsoft has begun testing the option to enable Intel's Advanced Performance Extensions, or APX, which will bring a performance boost to some apps — although no chips with APX support are available as yet.

items.title: Grab 32GB of DDR5 RAM for just $151 in this 4-in-1 Newegg bundle with the 9800X3D and a 2TB SSD
items.snippet: Grab the 9800X3D with a matching Gigabyte motherboard, 32GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 2TB SSD, all for just $1,180.99, giving you a $358.98 discount that makes the equivalent RAM price just $151.

items.title: Nvidia is bankrolling AI accelerator supply chain buildout to reserve production capacity
items.snippet: Nvidia is committing billions to expand substrate, co-packaged optics, advanced packaging, and chip-testing capacity through 2028, reserving capacity at nearly every stage of its AI accelerator supply chain.

items.title: 60,000 Microsoft employees offered voluntary buyouts as AI buildout costs bite
items.snippet: Microsoft is offering buyouts to around 60,000 members of its workforce as it looks to balance the books amid a ramp-up in AI data center spending.

items.title: Data center gear is being hijacked in transit to the tune of hundreds of millions
items.snippet: Data center gear is being stolen in transit to the tune of hundreds of millions — grand-theft-GPU thieves hack accounts, perform hit-and-runs, and spoof GPS signals

items.title: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt financing for GPUs expected in the first half of 2027, Musk says
items.snippet: SpaceX expects fourth-quarter capital expenditure of $35 billion to $40 billion, CFO Bret Johnsen said, as Elon Musk pushes to expand the company’s AI computing infrastructure.

items.title: Intel quietly confirms Raptor Lake Next CPUs through internal driver publication
items.snippet: An internal driver and a shipping manifest reveal that Intel's desktop Raptor Lake Next parts may be on the way right now.

items.title: JSAUX FlipGo dual-screen portable monitor review: Gorgeous displays with touch support and a built-in USB hub
items.snippet: The JSAUX FlipGo features dual 16-inch touch displays and a built-in hub.

items.title: Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 tested: Same performance, more comfortable, and a glorious OLED screen
items.snippet: Asus adds an OLED screen, TMR sticks, and more comfortable grips to its AMD-powered gaming handheld.

items.title: Leaked 256-core Zen 6c EPYC CPU destroys Zen 5 in early single-threaded benchmarks hints at 24% IPC gain
items.snippet: A benchmark leak and a direct clock-matched comparison from an enthusiast seed the idea that Zen 6 may come with a decent IPC bump as well as increased clocks.

items.title: Micron plans to use wafer bonding and High-NA EUV for next-gen DRAM
items.snippet: Micron rejects 4F2, intends to use wafer bonding and High-NA EUV before going 3D NAND over the next few years.

items.title: Intel's Lip-Bu Tan has spoken with Lisa Su about potential collaboration with AMD
items.snippet: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan has reportedly discussed potential areas of cooperation with AMD chief Lisa Su as Intel works to rebuild its CPU business and expand its foundry operations. The companies have already collaborated on x86 standards and CPU software, including AMD’s integration of its ZenDNN optimizations into Intel’s oneDNN library. Neither executive has publicly detailed the reported discussions or confirmed a new agreement.

items.title: Save over $1,000 on this Alienware gaming PC with an RTX 5070 and 32GB DDR5
items.snippet: Newegg have cut this Alienware Aurora gaming PC by over $1,000, netting yo ua 4K-ready machine with an RTX 5070 and 32GB of DDR5 RAM for $2,199.99.

items.title: Modder turns NES into a Windows-like desktop with original hardware

items.title: Replace SharePoint tempauth URLs with Entra ID tokens
items.snippet: On April 1, 2027, SharePoint Online and OneDrive will stop returning pre-authenticated URLs from Microsoft Graph, the REST API for Microsoft 365 data, for common file operations. Today those links carry a short-lived SharePoint credential in the tempauth query string, so a follow-up download or upload works without a token in an Authorization header. After the change, apps must send a Microsoft Entra ID access token in that header instead. Many flows then need two tokens: one for Graph and one for your SharePoint tenant host. A tenant setting can route some apps to Graph URLs so they stay on the Graph token only. Source

And while I've had some minor victories here and there, I've done nothing but fail to date in the sense that I'm looking for a repeatable process that always works. When I got started testing the RTX Spark computers, I assumed that I would quickly move across several different local AI use cases like general usage, software development, creative (image, video, etc.), productivity, agents, and whatever else. General usage, where you use local AI like any AI chatbot, is straightforward--like the Tolkien books and Mexico City itineraries I mentioned in RTX Spark: Real-World Local AI ⭐--and while that was a minor but nice success, I've really gotten stuck on the software development bit. items.title: Is it time to retire VPNs?
items.snippet: As legacy VPN vulnerabilities and AI-driven exploits expose corporate networks, zero-trust architecture is emerging as the imperative replacement, making systems invisible and preventing broad network access.
